pages.text: The $(item)True Sight Staff$() employs an $(#AA00AA)Marid$() to assist the summoner in tasks of finding and interacting with the otherworld.$(br) Unlike $(#AA00AA)Foliot$() in the otherworld goggles, which can only provide vision, with this staff in the off-hand or curio slot, the $()
occultist can collect otherworld materials.$(br) The divining rods search abilities receive an upgrade, now is possible locate any block.$(br2)
